post.description:
Start processing a source snapshot.

If an older ACTIVE workflow exists:

    - old workflow becomes SUPERSEDED
    - unfinished old tasks become CANCELLED
    - a new ACTIVE workflow is created

Repeating the call for the same snapshot is idempotent.

BusinessModelRevisionResponse.title: BusinessModelRevisionResponse
BusinessModelRevisionResponse.description:
Complete single revision.

Internal metadata storage:

    metadata_json = {
        "schema": {...},
        "schema_hash": "...",
        "schema_hash_version": 1,
        ...user metadata...
    }

API response separates those concerns.

revision lists could otherwise become extremely large.

WorkflowStartRequest.description:
Start a new processing generation for a source.

If another ACTIVE workflow exists for the source,
it will automatically be superseded.

WorkflowStatus.title: WorkflowStatus
WorkflowStatus.description:
ACTIVE
    Current workflow for a source.

COMPLETED
    All relevant work for this snapshot was completed.

SUPERSEDED
    A newer source snapshot appeared.
    Tasks from this workflow are no longer current.

FAILED
    Workflow could not be processed.

CANCELLED
    Explicitly cancelled by the system/user.
